visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair and a white turtleneck is indoors, holding three pregnancy tests and talking to the camera with a bright smile. (2) The scene changes to a low-angle perspective looking at a ceiling and curtains, while animated text and symbols appear. (3) A man in a grey t-shirt sits in an orange chair, his face covered by a bear emoji; he is handed a yellow envelope containing the tests. (4) A toddler in a yellow outfit sits in a stroller, grabbing a test stick and trying to put it in his mouth while heart and hand icons overlay the screen. (5) A montage of newborn photos follows, ending with the woman holding the toddler in a room decorated with large paintings.
